name: Craftsman's Writ: Greater Adept's Robe

angles.text: As a tailor, you can craft the Greater Adept's Robe yourself to fulfill the order.

faq.answer: Magus Tirth placed the order for the garment.
The order calls for a single Greater Adept's Robe delivered with the original writ.
The parchment denotes that the order is transferable, allowing any courier who holds it to fulfill the delivery.
faq.q: Can the writ be traded to another courier?

aliases: why does tirth want a robe
faq.answer: He wishes to wear the garment alongside his wizard hat.
faq.q: Why does Magus Tirth need the robe?

sections.body: A transferable work order penned in faded ink requests a single Greater Adept's Robe. It outlines delivery directions and payment terms for whoever holds the parchment. Completing the exchange requires bringing both the finished garment and the note directly to the buyer.
sections.title: An Open Order

sections.body: Magus Tirth eagerly awaits the arrival of his tailored garment. With the delivery in hand, he celebrates finally having his proper robe to wear with his wizard hat.
sections.title: The Robe and Wizard Hat

summary: A craftsman's writ calls for a Greater Adept's Robe to be delivered to an awaiting patron. The transferable order promises payment to anyone who supplies the garment and presents the note.
attribution: In-game quest text: Craftsman's Writ: Greater Adept's Robe
